title: UAAP: Adamson boys pull away from UPIS to snap losing skid
summary: Adamson University pulled away for a 99-83 win over UP Integrated School on Saturday to snap a three-game skid in the UAAP Season 89 High School Boys' 16-and-under Basketball Tournament.
